system_configurations.name: RCCL-MI350P-PCIe-8GPU-Func
system_configurations.description: Single-node 8x MI350P PCIe (gfx950, 1002:75a8). Debug build so rccl-UnitTestsFixturesDebug exists. AllReduce covers {Simple,LL} x {SHM,IPC} x Ring, plus LL x {SHM,IPC} x Tree, at channel counts 1,2,4,8,16,32,64. Tree+Simple is omitted: the gfx950 single-node tuner skips it and NCCL_ALGO=Tree then falls back to Ring. AllGather, ReduceScatter, and Broadcast spot checks are Ring only. AllToAll does not set NCCL_ALGO. SHM sets NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1. IPC sets NCCL_SHM_DISABLE=1 and NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS (cross-socket P2P). A labeled pull request runs --scope smoke (channels 1, 4, 32 plus the topology test and spot checks). Manual dispatch runs every enabled suite. The topology unit test needs no GPU.

tests.name: Mi350pPcieTopo_EightGfx950GpusNoXgmi
tests.description: CPU-only load of topo_8p_950_pcie.xml. Checks 8 gfx950 GPUs, device 0x75a8, PEX890 switches, and no XGMI paths.
